PLAN "12-Week Upper Body Programme — Subacromial Impingement (Right Shoulder)"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "Rebuild upper body strength with scapular stability, pain-free range, no overhead loading"

PHASES

  PHASE "Phase 1 — Scapular Control and Tissue Tolerance" (4 weeks):

    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Push — Horizontal and Low-Load":
        warmup:
          cycling 10m
        main straight_sets:
          cat_cow 2x10 rpe 4 rest 30 seconds
          scapular_retraction 3x12 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          prone_T 3x12 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          prone_Y 3x12 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          push_up 3x8..10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          dumbbell_fly 3x10 rpe 5 rest 90 seconds
          external_rotation 3x15 rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 2m
          shoulder_stretch 2m
          child_pose 2m

      DAY Wednesday training 45m "Pull — Horizontal":
        warmup:
          cycling 10m
        main straight_sets:
          cat_cow 2x10 rpe 4 rest 30 seconds
          scapular_retraction 3x12 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          prone_W 3x12 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          face_pull 3x15 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          seated_row 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          dumbbell_row 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          rear_delt_fly 3x12 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          external_rotation 3x15 rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          lat_stretch 2m
          back_stretch 2m
          child_pose 2m

      DAY Friday training 45m "Full Body Accessory and Core":
        warmup:
          walking 8m
        main straight_sets:
          dead_bug 3x8 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          bird_dog 3x10 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds

          goblet_squat 3x10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
